title: fln-hash canon: recursive Expr/Level decoders stack-overflow (SIGABRT) on deep untrusted input
description:
Canonical Expr and Level decoding currently uses recursive descent once per attacker-controlled nesting tag. A compact malicious artifact or wire payload can exhaust a normal Rust worker stack and trigger an uncatchable SIGABRT, violating the decoder totality contract, D8, and FL-INV-07. Replace both recursive readers with explicit heap-backed state machines while preserving the exact canonical wire format, result values, typed errors, and compatibility for legitimate deep mathlib terms. A hard nesting cap is not an acceptable substitute because it can reject valid artifacts; caller resource budgets may stop work only through the typed inconclusive/resource path.

## Steps to Reproduce

In a sacrificial child process or spawned thread with an explicit 8 MiB and 2 MiB stack, feed a valid schema header followed by a long Expr App-tag chain, and separately Level Succ/Max/IMax chains, without enough leaves. Increase depth until the current implementation prints stack overflow and exits by SIGABRT. The established reproduction overflows around 20k to 50k Expr frames in release on 8 MiB and around 1k to 2k in debug; exact thresholds are evidence, not acceptance constants. Fatal probes must never execute in the main test-runner process.

## Acceptance Criteria

Expr and Level decoding use no input-depth recursion in tag parsing, child scheduling, assembly, or error cleanup. The implementation accepts every previously valid byte sequence subject only to existing format and explicit resource rules; emits byte-for-byte identical canonical re-encodings and hashes; reports malformed, truncated, over-budget, cancelled, and allocation-failure cases through stable typed outcomes; performs linear work in consumed input plus produced nodes; and cannot panic or abort on arbitrary bytes. State-machine invariants, frame variants, maximum pending work, and partial-value cleanup are documented.

Named unit/property/mutation tests cover every Expr and Level constructor; truncation at every field boundary; invalid tags/indices/lengths; highly unbalanced and alternating shapes; at least 100k attacker-controlled nesting tags under a 2 MiB stack; random malformed bytes; budget and cancellation boundaries; and old-versus-new semantic/wire/hash equivalence on exhaustive shallow plus corpus fixtures. A real no-mock CLI/artifact E2E runs bounded-stack child probes for deep malformed inputs, asserts typed exit with no signal/hang/survivor, then performs a clean recovery decode. Emit concise human logs and bounded schema-versioned NDJSON with seed/depth/shape/input hash, stack/build/toolchain/host, budgets/timings/resources, expected versus actual, exit/signal, stderr/stdout artifacts, first divergence, cleanup and final state. The separate franken_lean-canon-stack-safe-drop-6gy bead owns destruction of successfully built very deep DAGs and blocks the parent fln-hash closeout.
design: Use iterative explicit work frames for Expr and Level. Each frame records the constructor tag, already decoded scalar fields, the next child slot, and child results; a separate value stack assembles nodes only after all children succeed. Reads remain canonical and forward-only, lengths/indices remain checked before allocation, and partial failures unwind heap containers rather than the call stack. Preserve error precedence and offsets exactly where they are compatibility-visible. Prove depth-independent call-stack usage with a bounded-stack child test and mutation-kill a deliberately recursive variant. Do not use unsafe code, increase thread stacks, catch aborts in-process, leak partial trees, or add a semantic depth cap.
acceptance_criteria: All requirements in the description and design are mandatory. The old fatal reproducer exits through a typed error in 100 consecutive bounded-stack child runs for both Expr and Level families with zero SIGABRT, panic, hang, or survivor; clean inputs immediately afterward decode and hash identically. The complete unit/property/mutation/corpus differential suite and the real child-process E2E pass with independently valid detailed logs. franken_lean-canon-stack-safe-drop-6gy remains an explicit blocker for full fln-hash lifecycle closure.
notes:
cc_3 — THE LAST CRITERION IS DISCHARGED; the bead stays open only on a mechanical block.

'Resource exhaustion may only surface through the typed inconclusive/resource path, never as a panic or a rejection' is now satisfied. fln-4zk8 landed in e529081 and is closed; the criterion is discharged by canon::tests::budget_exhaustion_on_a_valid_artifact_is_inconclusive_never_a_verdict, which drives a caller-supplied budget to exhaustion on a VALID artifact — the same bytes decode cleanly with room to work, so Malformed would be a lie about the bytes and Value would mean the budget was ignored — and asserts Decoded::Inconclusive carrying the limit that fired, what was allowed, what was spent, and the offset reached. malformed_input_under_a_generous_budget_is_still_a_rejection proves the two outcomes do not collapse in either direction, and the budget is not a nesting cap: it counts produced nodes and consumed bytes, so legitimately deep terms are never refused for being deep.

ALSO SETTLED, because a reader of this bead's history will look for it: the 2026-07-22 review comment flagged that partial-error cleanup was not stack-safe — an App or Max whose first child is a deep valid subterm and whose second child is truncated would assemble the deep child, then recursively release it while unwinding. That gap is closed by construction now: franken_lean-canon-stack-safe-drop-6gy made Expr/Level Drop an iterative Arc::into_inner drain, so releasing that value stack no longer recurses. It is directly evidenced, not merely argued: the sacrificial-child probe builds exactly that shape (a LEVEL_MAX/EXPR_APP header followed by one deep child and no second child), asserts the typed 'input truncated', and runs at depth 100000 and 1000000 on a 1 MiB stack in scripts/e2e/canon_lifecycle.sh, which passed on this tree.

WHY IT IS STILL OPEN: br refuses the close — 'Skipped franken_lean-fnj: blocked by: franken_lean-canon-stack-safe-drop-6gy'. 6gy is mine and its implementation is complete; it is held open only for a green ./scripts/check.sh, which cannot pass right now for two reasons that are not mine and not this bead's:
  1. cargo clippy -p structure-guard --all-targets -D warnings still exits 101 (tools/structure-guard, another pane's in-flight crate);
  2. kernel_contract still reports bead-evidence/stale-binding. The regeneration landed and picked up fln-1f8v and fln-4zk8, and the gap is now exactly ONE id: franken_lean-83pz is live in .beads/issues.jsonl but absent from ci/KERNEL_CONTRACT_OWNERSHIP.jsonl (236 projected vs 237 live). Whoever owns the next regeneration only needs to pick that one up. I did not regenerate.
Once check.sh is green, 6gy closes on its own evidence and fnj closes immediately after; no further work is owed on fnj itself.
close_reason:
Every criterion is now discharged on the tree.

The premise was stale and is recorded as such: both readers were ALREADY explicit heap-backed state machines (read_level_iter/read_expr_iter with a value stack; Name and KVMap are bounded loops; DataValue cannot contain an Expr), so no recursive descent was replaced. What was missing was evidence, supplied in 4d0d0f4: a decode-side mutation kill requiring byte-grammar-identical recursive readers to die of stack exhaustion in their own processes against a passing control; exhaustive truncation at every field boundary; and seeded corruption. The 2,000,000-tag bounded-stack regression asserts a typed 'input truncated' rather than a depth cap, so no artificial nesting limit was introduced.

The last criterion — resource exhaustion surfaces only through the typed inconclusive path — was UNMET rather than untested until a caller budget existed to exhaust. fln-4zk8 built that surface (e529081) and bca0954 discharges the criterion: deep_hostile_input_over_budget_is_inconclusive_never_a_verdict drives 1,000,000 nesting tags to exhaustion on a 1 MiB worker and checks all four prohibitions — never a SIGABRT (the join proves it), never a panic (a panic fails that join), never a rejection (the same bytes under an unlimited budget return Malformed 'input truncated' instead, so the outcomes are genuinely distinct), and never cacheable (an inconclusive decode yields no value). Both limits are exercised, and the byte-budget case asserts no byte past the cap was consumed.

comments.text:
ROOT CAUSE (Claude Fable review session, 2026-07-22): crates/fln-hash/src/canon.rs Expr::read_body and Level::read_body are recursive-descent decoders that recurse once per nesting level of ATTACKER-CONTROLLED bytes (Expr via App/Lam/ForallE/LetE/MData/Proj/Sort/Const; Level via Succ/Max/IMax). There is no depth bound. A crafted artifact that is just a schema header followed by a chain of EXPR_APP tag bytes (0x05) drives unbounded call-stack recursion.

REPRODUCTION (verified): decode a chain of ~2,000,000 EXPR_APP tags on a std thread with an 8 MiB stack (Linux default; what std/asupersync worker threads get) -> 'thread has overflowed its stack; fatal runtime error: stack overflow, aborting' (SIGABRT). Threshold on 8 MiB stack: release build overflows between depth 20k-50k (~200 B/frame); debug build overflows between 1k-2k (~4 KB/frame); a 2 MiB spawned test thread overflows around a few hundred. So a <=2 MB malicious .olean/receipt/olean-next artifact or wire message aborts the whole process/daemon.

This is masked on the dev box ONLY because ulimit -s is unlimited there (recursion just gets slow, no crash). It is fully reachable on any normal deployment.

SEVERITY: violates the codec's own stated contract (canon.rs:11 'Decoding is total over arbitrary bytes: every failure is a typed CanonError, never a panic') and doctrine D8 / FL-INV-07 (malformed artifacts/protocol messages must not panic; a stack-overflow abort is strictly WORSE than a panic — uncatchable, kills the process, no typed Inconclusive). The canon codec is exactly the untrusted-input surface (decl content digests, receipts, olean-next, Diagnostic-on-the-wire).

WHY A DEPTH CAP IS NOT THE FIX: any hard recursion cap safe on the smallest realistic decode stack (~hundreds on a 2 MB test thread) is BELOW what legitimate mathlib oleans can reach (long app spines, nested binders in the low thousands), so a cap would false-reject valid artifacts — breaking the .olean read surface, which §4.1 forbids breaking casually. The correct fix is an ITERATIVE (explicit heap work-stack) decoder: decode depth bounded by heap (input size), not call stack — no overflow, no false rejects.

COVERAGE GAP that let this exist: the existing 'malformed_inputs_are_typed_errors_never_panics' test only exercises small malformed inputs; it never tests deep nesting.

RELATED latent issue (separate, note only): dropping a very deep valid Expr/Level tree (nested Arc<ExprNode>) also recurses in Drop and could overflow — but that requires already holding a deep tree in memory. Out of scope for this decode-path fix; worth a follow-up if deep valid oleans exist.

FIXING NOW in this session: converting both decoders to iterative explicit-stack machines that preserve the exact wire format, plus a bounded-stack regression test. canon.rs is committed-clean and idle (mtime 4h).

title: G0-9: Instrumented-oracle spike — golden decision traces schema, volume, replay rig
description:
G0-9 Instrumented-oracle spike (§22.1-9, feeds §18.3): patch the Reference IN THE TRIBUNAL SANDBOX (build-time-only, test-only, never shipped, never linked — D8) to dump decision traces at the points our native machinery must match — unifier approximation choices, postponements, unfoldings and their order, instance-search candidate orders and outcomes, macro expansions, simp rewrite firings, heartbeat consumption — on a pilot corpus, and prove the trace schema, volume, and replay-rig design.

Why this exists: under the Oracle-Only Law there is NO hosted upstream engine to fall back to, so the unifier/instance/simp fidelity burden (Critical risk R2) is carried entirely by evidence. Golden decision traces at Corpus scale are the strongest available mitigation: Athanor, Synod, and Anvil are implemented AGAINST the traces, not against vibes, and trace-replay rigs run continuously thereafter.

Acceptance: (a) the patched-oracle build recipe is scripted, hashed, and reproducible in the sandbox; (b) trace schema versioned and validated (typed events, source anchors, stable ids); (c) volume measured on the pilot corpus with a stated projection to Corpus scale (storage in the Tribunal frankensqlite store); (d) a replay rig prototype diffs a hand-written toy unifier against traces to prove the comparison machinery. Traces are fixtures, never components; the generator lives behind the D8 wall. Tests: the pilot traces + replay rig land in fln-conformance as the seed of the continuous golden-trace lanes.

## Acceptance Criteria

All bead-specific requirements, acceptance conditions, tests, invariants, compatibility surfaces, evidence levels, performance gates, negative/recovery cases, and user-visible behaviors stated above remain mandatory. In addition, the MANDATORY VERIFICATION DEFINITION OF DONE in Notes must be satisfied with named unit/property/mutation suites, at least one shared real-path no-mock E2E scenario plus failure/recovery coverage, detailed human and schema-versioned NDJSON artifacts, and reproducible close evidence. No listed feature or claim may be silently narrowed, deferred, mocked, or declared complete through an unclassified divergence.
design:
TraceContractV1 makes instrumentation noninterference a prerequisite, not an assumption. Each event carries schema/epoch, declaration/request/phase IDs, causal parent and scope stack, event-family tag, family-local payload, deterministic source anchor and ordinal, completeness/truncation state, and exact resource facts. Pointer addresses, allocator order, host paths, timestamps and compression layout never define semantic identity.

The exact clean Reference binary and patched binary with tracing disabled must agree on acceptance, diagnostics, environment/artifact bytes, generated names and heartbeat/depth facts. With tracing enabled, the patched run must preserve those same outputs and decision order. Trace capture cannot allocate through or otherwise perturb the counted Lean path; heartbeat capture uses an out-of-band/preallocated mechanism or an equivalently demonstrated non-perturbing design. Repeated-run divergence is retained and classified, never normalized away. A patch that changes the observed program is not an oracle.

Backpressure, event/byte/depth/storage limits, interruption and corruption yield a typed incomplete trace with authority=false. An incomplete trace may diagnose but cannot become a golden fixture or implementation target. Raw trace chunks are content-bound before optional compression/indexing; decompression and index rebuild recover the exact event stream. Retention policy distinguishes authoritative raw fixtures from rebuildable indexes and telemetry.

The replay prototype covers every event family, not only the toy unifier: at least one independent minimal consumer/checker for unifier/postponement/unfold, instance search, macro expansion, simp firing and heartbeat/depth events, with planted omission, reordering, payload and outcome divergences. Replay comparison reports the earliest causal divergence without over-normalizing observable order.

G0 DECISION INTEGRATION — emit exactly one G0SpikeDecisionV1 whose domain payload is TraceContractV1. Outcome is RatifyInstrumentedOracleContract, AmendTraceContract, or NoGo mapped to Ratified/Amended/NoGo. Ratification requires noninterference, complete representative event-family replay/checker coverage, bounded raw/compressed/indexed volumes, causal ids/scopes, D8 boundary scans, productive deterministic work where parallel, and independent regeneration from raw traces. Missing event families, incomplete trace presented authoritative, patch perturbation, replay-only self-consistency, schema/root mismatch, hidden oracle reachability, telemetry mixed into semantics, Inconclusive/InternalFault, or a trace volume with no viable archival/replay contract blocks.

PRODUCTIVE THREAD AMENDMENT — fixed governed pilot inputs run at 1, 8, and 32 threads with actual nonempty trace-capture/replay/index-validation partitions wherever event dependencies permit and deterministic canonical reduction of semantic artifacts. Intrinsically ordered event production remains ordered and is not counted as parallel work. The semantic trace/event/index roots and G0 decision are identical across the matrix; host/scheduler/timing variation remains telemetry. A relabeled sequential loop, empty worker partitions, schedule-derived event ids/order, or thread-profile mismatch blocks ratification.
acceptance_criteria:
A scripted, hashed, reproducible, build-time/test-only Reference patch in the Tribunal sandbox emits versioned typed traces for unifier approximations/postponements, unfold choices/order, instance candidate order/outcomes, macro expansions, simp firings, heartbeat/fuel consumption, source anchors, stable declaration/event ids, and explicit truncation/resource facts on a reviewed pilot corpus. The patch and traces remain fixtures/generators only, never linked, shipped, or callable as a FrankenLean component; source and artifact scans prove the D8 wall. Schema validation rejects unknown/duplicate/out-of-order/impossible events and binds exact pin, patch, binary, corpus and environment roots. Volume, compression, indexing and replay costs are measured with raw pilot data and a justified Corpus-scale frankensqlite projection plus bounded retention policy. A replay prototype drives a hand-written toy unifier and detects planted choice/order/outcome divergences with exact first-divergence output, proving comparison machinery rather than mere logging. Unit/property/model/mutation tests cover schema/events, stable ids, ordering, truncation, resource/cancellation/fault behavior, storage/replay, and D8 compile-out; named dropped-event, reordered-candidate, unstable-id, over-normalizer, hidden-oracle, and surviving-divergence mutants are killed. Real no-mock E2E builds the patched Reference, records/replays pilot traces, plants/restores a divergence, handles interruption/corruption, and retains strict build/trace/store/process/cleanup bundles. The traces and replay lane enter permanent CI; dependencies, scripts/check.sh, cargo/fmt/clippy/UBS and artifact scans pass. No runtime oracle component, unversioned ad-hoc text log, sampled trace without manifest, mock-only Reference, silently truncated trace, divergence normalized away, unsupported volume claim, or deferred listed event family satisfies closure.

A noninterference matrix compares clean, patched-disabled and patched-enabled Reference runs over every pilot fixture and repeated seeds. Governed semantic outputs, decision events and heartbeat/depth counters must match exactly; timing may differ only in the separate telemetry stream. Source patch, build inputs, binary, configuration and run manifests are content-bound. D8 compile-out and release-artifact scans prove no patch, generator entry point or oracle-call path is reachable from product binaries.

Event-family schema/model/property tests cover nesting, causal parents, ordinals, stable anchors, every payload/tag, repeated/failed branches, truncation, chunking, compression, index reconstruction, limits, cancellation, corruption and recovery. Mutants perturb instrumentation behavior, allocate on the counted path, omit/reorder/duplicate an event, destabilize IDs, mark truncated complete, rebuild a different stream, over-normalize a divergence, hide an oracle path or merge telemetry; each is killed discriminatingly.

The real lane records and independently replays at least one representative scenario for every required family, plus combined traces, planted divergences, exact restoration, interrupted/incomplete capture, corrupt chunk/index and clean recovery. Productive repeated/thread-profile runs use fixed governed inputs; any Reference nondeterminism remains an explicit finding and cannot be converted into a golden total order.

Strict semantic evidence contains pin/patch/binary/corpus/declaration/event/scope/parent IDs, source anchors, completeness, raw/chunk/compressed digests, limits/usage, expected/actual event and first causal divergence, authority, mutation, restoration and final state. Host/timing/volume telemetry is a separate bounded stream. Validators reject patch/input drift, noninterference failure, missing families, incomplete golden traces, cross-stream contamination, unstable IDs, wrong mutants, surviving divergences or unsupported Corpus-scale projection.
notes: CORRECTION (2026-07-29, CobaltLantern, from the 4xsz option census): the increment-2 trace-class census of 399 included two doc-example phantoms (trace.class.name, trace.foo.bar from Trace.lean doc comments, lines 25/376). True population: 397. Zero-heartbeat-classes and all family-matrix conclusions unaffected. Details: bead-comment franken_lean-4xsz:1675 and commit 2f2cad9a.

title: W3: Crucible K2 — NbE accelerator, memoized whnf, cross-checked against K1
description:
Implement Crucible engine K2, the NbE accelerator (§8.3): normalization-by-evaluation with environment-aware closures, memoized whnf keyed on (term-hash, transparency), lazy delta with definitional-height comparison — the engine that makes decide, big Fin computations, and mathlib defeq-heavy corners fast (the PG-1/PG-2 arithmetic depends on it; the design was priced by spike G0-7).

Laws: K2 implements the SAME judgments as K1 (one KERNEL_CONTRACT); K2 verdicts are spot-audited against K1 continuously (sampled per run, exhaustively in Tribunal soaks) and any disagreement fails loudly and ships as a fixture; every fast-lane shortcut carries exactly one registered justification — a local proof argument in the kernel design note, a certificate checked by a simpler routine, or differential evidence (which licenses an optimization and never impersonates a proof). The size covenant counts K2 lines too. Cache keying uses the alpha-canonical digest lane (§7.1b) so alpha-varied duplicates share reduction work invisibly to metaprograms.

Acceptance: the G0-7 twenty-problem tail suite meets the envelope the PG-2 model requires; K1/K2 continuous cross-check wired and green on the full fixture corpus; PG-1 trajectory measured (full mathlib olean recheck time on the 32-core profile). Tests: differential K1-vs-K2 on generated term storms; memoization-correctness property tests (cached verdict == fresh verdict under transparency changes); fuel-parity fixtures shared with G0-6 stay green on both engines.

## Acceptance Criteria

All bead-specific requirements, acceptance conditions, tests, invariants, compatibility surfaces, evidence levels, performance gates, negative/recovery cases, and user-visible behaviors stated above remain mandatory. In addition, the MANDATORY VERIFICATION DEFINITION OF DONE in Notes must be satisfied with named unit/property/mutation suites, at least one shared real-path no-mock E2E scenario plus failure/recovery coverage, detailed human and schema-versioned NDJSON artifacts, and reproducible close evidence. No listed feature or claim may be silently narrowed, deferred, mocked, or declared complete through an unclassified divergence.
design: FL-INV-02 ACCELERATOR BOUNDARY — K2 may accelerate the same judgment but cannot expose a second admission API or mint an accepted state through unchecked memoized data. Cache entries and NbE shortcuts remain internal evidence; the common fln-kernel authority gate validates status, epoch, environment root, declaration hash, resource outcome, and required K1 cross-check policy before any opaque checked result exists. Unknown/stale cache versions recompute and disagreement halts.
acceptance_criteria:
K2 implements exactly the K1/KERNEL_CONTRACT judgments using NbE with environment-aware closures, alpha-canonical term digests, memoized whnf keyed by term/environment/transparency and schema, and lazy delta ordered by definitional height. Every optimization has one registered local proof, simpler checked certificate, or clearly scoped differential justification; none can mint acceptance outside the common kernel authority. Cache entries are internal evidence, versioned and root-bound; stale/unknown/mismatched entries recompute. Configured deterministic content-seeded K1 cross-checking runs continuously and exhaustive fixture/soak cross-checking finds zero disagreement; any mismatch halts, retains both traces and shrinks a fixture. Unit/property/model/metamorphic/mutation suites cover cached-versus-fresh equivalence under transparency/environment/epoch changes, binders, alpha variants, universes, fuel, budgets, cancellation, eviction, concurrency, and authority; named stale-key, unsound-sharing, wrong-delta, skipped-cross-check, forged-cache-success, and fuel-drift mutants are killed. The twenty G0-7 tail fixtures meet the ratified PG-2 envelope with identical judgments and raw tail evidence, and fuel-parity fixtures agree across engines. Real no-mock K1/K2 E2E runs corpus and generated term storms, plants cache/cross-check divergences, restores, and retains strict key/root/verdict/trace/resource bundles. Dependencies, scripts/check.sh, cargo/fmt/clippy/UBS, line covenant, differential/mutation/fault/thread/performance lanes pass. No second admission API, unchecked memoized verdict, runtime-random sampling, speed-for-semantics trade, timing-only validation, hidden stale reuse, unresolved disagreement, or deferred listed K2 behavior satisfies closure.

REVIEW AMENDMENT — cache and memo keys bind canonical environment root, local-context identity, transparency, epoch/schema/build, all read dependencies, and completion status. Hashes accelerate lookup but never establish equality: injected collisions compare canonical keys and cannot cross-hit. Partial, cancelled, exhausted, Inconclusive, InternalFault, or dependency-unknown work cannot be cached as a semantic answer or negative. Property tests cover canonical-key equality, collision buckets, invalidation, and failure-atomic retry.

EVIDENCE CONTRACT — authoritative output is strict schema-versioned canonical semantic NDJSON containing normalized inputs, roots, typed outcomes, resource class/consumption, decisions, first divergence, cleanup, and exact final state. Host, PID, wall time, temporary paths, cache/performance facts, and scheduler details live only in a separately linked bounded telemetry stream and cannot enter authoritative digests. Validators reject merged streams, unknown versions, extra or missing fields, broken linkage/order, silent truncation, or telemetry-root drift. Productive 1/8/32 runs prove nonempty completed work and deterministic reduction rather than thread-count labels.
notes:
MANDATORY VERIFICATION DEFINITION OF DONE (inherits franken_lean-rur; additive to this bead's own Tests/Acceptance):
1. Unit coverage: deterministic happy-path, boundary, malformed-input, resource-exhaustion, cancellation, and failure-atomicity cases for every new public behavior; property/metamorphic and mutation-kill tests wherever an invariant or equivalence is claimed.
2. E2E coverage: add or extend at least one shared scripts/e2e scenario for the real user-visible path, plus a negative/recovery scenario. Release-level evidence uses the no-mock lane (real Reference binary/artifact/filesystem/editor/process/host as applicable). A mock may support a unit test but may not close an L-level, PG gate, or public claim.
3. Detailed logs: emit both concise human logs and schema-versioned NDJSON with run/scenario/step ids; bead, claim, invariant, Parity-Ledger row, and gate ids; exact command/argv with secrets redacted; cwd; epoch/mode/profile/platform/thread-count/seed/cache-state/host facts; canonical input hashes; expected vs actual; monotonic start/end/duration; resource and budget facts; exit status/signal; stdout/stderr artifact references; receipt/logical roots; first-divergence data; cleanup and asserted final state. Never swallow stderr, never leak secrets, and bound adversarial log volume.
4. CI/closeout: archive logs, fixtures, repro bundles, and evidence manifests; failures must be diagnosable from artifacts alone. Run scripts/check.sh, cargo test, the bead-specific unit/property suites, relevant Tribunal differential/mutation/fault lanes, and the shared E2E scenario. The close evidence names every test/scenario id and artifact location; skips require a typed, logged, honest L-level limitation and may not satisfy the skipped claim.

title: Gate lock engages only if the caller volunteers, and no artifact records whether it did
description:
The gate lock only engages if the caller volunteers, and nothing records whether it did: a guard whose producer is optional and whose engagement is unobservable.

MEASURED 2026-07-27T06:3xZ at HEAD 76298969 by cc_1 (PeachBass), extending franken_lean-build-gate-lane-governed-set-98np comment 1387. Repair surface is scripts/e2e/*.sh and scripts/check.sh, which are cod_2's.

FINDING 1 -- NO LANE ACQUIRES THE GATE LOCK. A search over tracked .sh, .py, .rs, .yml and .toml surfaces (excluding target/ and vendor/) for the string fln-gate.lockfile returns ZERO hits. The only flock in any tracked script is:

  scripts/extract/gen_extern_census.sh:  flock -w 2400 200
  scripts/extract/census_materialize.sh: flock -w 2400 200

which is PUBLICATION_LOCK on fd 200, the census publication lock, a different lock for a different purpose. /data/tmp/fln-gate.lockfile is named in no tracked executable surface at all.

The lock is therefore acquired ONLY by whoever wraps the invocation, e.g.

  flock -w 2400 /data/tmp/fln-gate.lockfile bash scripts/check.sh

A lane, a full check.sh, or the evidence self-test launched WITHOUT that wrapper is fully functional. It does not warn. It does not fail. It runs, unprotected, and every other pane's flock -n /data/tmp/fln-gate.lockfile -c true probe reports FREE for its entire duration.

AGENTS.md already records ONE way a FREE probe can be wrong: lanes acquire with a WAITING flock -w 2400, so a dispatched-but-queued lane leaves the lock reading free. This is a SECOND and independent way, and it is worse in kind, because no amount of re-probing detects it. In the first case something eventually takes the lock. In this case nothing ever touches the file, so there is no state for any probe to observe.

FINDING 2 -- NO ARTIFACT RECORDS WHETHER THE LOCK WAS HELD. Measured against the attempt-8 bundle, target/check/check-20260727T055459Z-3616684, the deepest run produced to date (fourteen stages executed, thirteen green):

  - grep for fln-gate / gate_lock / gate-lock across the entire run directory: ZERO hits.
  - check.meta.json keys: argv, argv_redacted, cancel_signal, child_exit, child_signal,
    classification, cwd, duration_ns, ended_utc, errors, host, monotonic_end_ns, monotonic_start_ns,
    phase_timing, planted, readiness, reason_code, resource, schema, sealed_compiler,
    sealed_interpreter, semantic_failure_exits, stage_id, started_utc, stderr, stdout,
    target_exec, test_control, wrapper_exit. No key mentions a lock.
  - check.ready.json (fln.supervisor-readiness/3) carries child_pgid, child_pid, child_sid,
    child_start_ticks, monotonic_ns, supervisor_pid, supervisor_start_ticks, wrapper_pid,
    wrapper_start_ticks. Process identity, no lock identity.

So no completed run -- including one launched correctly under the wrapper, which attempt 8 was -- can demonstrate after the fact that it executed under the freeze. Every "the swarm was parked" statement attached to tonight's evidence rests on operator testimony, not on anything inside the artifact.

THE SHAPE. This is AGENTS.md item 7 at the PROCESS layer rather than the evidence layer. The claim is "this run executed under the repository freeze"; the producer of that property is the flock wrapper; and nothing joins them. It is additionally the bkw6 empty-referent variant, because there is no artifact on the far end to compare the claim against -- the question is not whether a recorded value drifted, but whether the thing the sentence describes exists at all for this run.

WHY THE OBVIOUS REPAIR IS THE WRONG ONE. Adding a lock-engagement field to the run record does not fix this; it relocates the trust. A process reporting on its own lock acquisition is a self-attestation, and an unwrapped lane would simply record acquired=false -- or, if the field defaults, record nothing and be read as legacy. The honest repair is STRUCTURAL: the lane must acquire the lock ITSELF, so that "the lane ran" entails "the lock was held" by construction rather than by report. Make the producer mandatory instead of attesting that an optional producer ran.

That also removes a live footgun: the wrapper is currently typed by hand at each launch, so the timeout, the path and the flag are all re-entered from memory every time. A lane that self-acquires cannot be launched with the wrong lock path.

BOUNDARY -- WHAT THIS BEAD DOES NOT OWN, stated because two neighbours are close.

  franken_lean-build-gate-lane-governed-set-98np owns which paths each lane governs and the
  semantics of the four (now five) detection mechanisms M1-M5. That is about what VOIDS a lane
  once it is running. This bead is about whether the mutual exclusion that is supposed to keep
  other panes out ever engaged.

  franken_lean-verification-receipt-producer-binding-ywmq (cod_2) owns binding the producing
  repository HEAD and the governed-path-set identity through run_start, the evidence manifest,
  the bundle marker, validation and compact receipts. That is about what a bundle BINDS about
  repository state. This bead is about whether a process-level guard RAN. Note ywmq's own
  acceptance criteria say "Any main-tree check.sh or e2e run follows the gate-lock and
  explicit-GO protocol" -- treating the protocol as given, which is precisely the assumption
  this finding falsifies. The two do not overlap and neither subsumes the other.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

1. Every lane script, scripts/check.sh, and the evidence self-test acquire the gate lock themselves (directly or through one shared preamble), so a launch without an external wrapper is impossible rather than merely discouraged. The lock path is named at one site, not re-typed per launch.
2. Attempting to run while the lock is held blocks or refuses typed; it never proceeds unprotected. A second concurrent launch is demonstrated to be excluded.
3. Negative control, in the direction that matters: a build in which the self-acquisition is removed must make a named test FAIL FOR THE STATED REASON, not merely exit non-zero. A run that silently proceeds without the lock is the defect and must be the thing the test catches.
4. Both directions. A change that makes acquisition unconditionally claim success is refused by its own control, so the guard cannot be disarmed into always-green.
5. The lock path is derived and shared rather than transcribed, so a future lane cannot acquire a DIFFERENT file and read as protected. A planted mutant that changes the path in one lane only is killed.
6. Evidence: a full scripts/check.sh run under the repaired arrangement, cited with its anchor, plus the exclusion demonstration from criterion 2.

WHAT THIS BEAD DOES NOT CLAIM. No lane is claimed to have actually run unwrapped. The finding is that nothing would prevent it, nothing would detect it, and nothing in any retained artifact could tell the two cases apart afterwards. Whether it has happened is not established and, given finding 2, is not establishable from the evidence that exists. Class bounded_model: one host, one commit, one bundle inspected.
close_reason: All 4 acceptance criteria met and bound by per-commit guards: 21/21 lanes self-acquire (governed-sets equality), contention refused typed (discriminator cell 4), gutted-refusal mutant killed (cell 5), guard inversion catches wiring removal by name. Residual: standalone self-test outside check.sh documented. Comment 2749

THE DEFECT. fln_gate_inherited scans /proc/self/fd for a link equal to the lockfile path and returns
0 -- "an ancestor holds the gate" -- on a match. That premise is FALSE for a descriptor that was
OPENED and NEVER LOCKED, and the two are indistinguishable by any path scan. In that state
fln_gate_acquire returns 0, sets FLN_GATE_STATE=inherited, journals acquired-inherited, and the lane
runs to completion BELIEVING IT HELD THE FREEZE WHILE NOTHING HELD IT -- then writes that claim into
an append-only journal, making it durable rather than merely believed.

producer does not exist. Same shape AGENTS.md item 7 records where the guard that admitted four
unprotected rigs was itself the mechanism for an instance in that table.

MEASURED, ONE VARIABLE AT A TIME:

  CELL F  parent does exec 3>LOCK and never flocks it, then the detector runs
          detector=inherited   second-fd-probe=ACQUIRED (nothing held it)
  CELL G  parent is a genuine flock -w 5 LOCK child
          detector=inherited   second-fd-probe=BLOCKED (genuinely held)

fln_gate_inherited returns 0 in BOTH rows.

descriptor on the same file discriminates the two cases outright: a genuine ancestor lock conflicts
with it, a merely-open fd does not. Added fln_gate_confirm_inherited, which opens fd 9 and tries a
NON-BLOCKING acquire -- -n, never -w, so the probe cannot block and cell B's hang is untouched:

  returns 0 => an ancestor genuinely holds it; do NOT re-acquire (that is the 40-minute hang)
  returns 1 => the fd was a decoy and nothing held it; fd 9 now does, so this REPAIRS rather than
               merely diagnoses, and the journal records acquired-after-unlocked-fd
  returns 2 => the lockfile could not be opened at all

Also uses >> rather than > so the open never truncates a file another process may be holding.

THE HOLDER-NAMER NO LONGER USES fuser — repaired, with the old form's WRONG ANSWER captured
side-by-side in the same run

cc_1. AGENTS.md records this as a LIVE defect against this bead: "scripts/lib/gate_lock.sh's
fln_gate_name_holder still uses the fuser form at f5359c22, so this is a live defect and not a
repaired one." Re-tested before acting, because a recorded block expires: still true at HEAD,
line 61, `/usr/bin/fuser "$FLN_GATE_LOCKFILE"`. Now repaired.

WHY fuser IS WRONG, and it is wrong in the direction that manufactures the very phantom freeze
this function exists to prevent. A lock belongs to the open file DESCRIPTION; fuser and lsof
report every process holding a DESCRIPTOR. A process that has merely done `exec 7>>lock` and
never locked is reported as a holder while the gate is FREE by ground truth. fuser's own ACCESS
column reads `F`, meaning open for writing — it never claimed to mean locked.

THE REPLACEMENT is /proc/locks, the kernel's record of actual holdings: one FLOCK row per held
lock carrying the holding pid and MAJOR:MINOR:INODE. Matched on the inode from stat, with our
own pid and ppid excluded so a probe cannot report itself. Waiter rows beginning with `->` are
skipped DELIBERATELY and with a comment saying why: they shift every column, and misreading one
as a holder reports a freeze that does not exist.

THREE OUTCOMES, NOT TWO, and this is structural rather than an edge case. /proc/<pid>/cwd is
unreadable for a process owned by another user, which on this shared box is the COMMON case, so
a two-bucket classifier must put every such holder somewhere and is wrong whichever it picks. A
holder whose cwd cannot be read is reported UNATTRIBUTED — neither a lane nor a stray. A holder
whose cwd is a different checkout is reported FOREIGN, because `scripts/check.sh` is not a
unique name on a machine hosting a dozen FrankenSuite repositories, and argv alone once froze a
pane for twenty minutes on a repository nothing was holding.

MEASURED, four cells on a SCRATCH lockfile so the real gate was never touched, ground truth
taken from `flock -n` in every cell:

  1  fresh lockfile, nothing touching it     truth FREE   namer: names nothing
  2  a process holding a DESCRIPTOR, no lock truth FREE   fuser: names pid 2314218
                                                          namer: NAMES NOTHING
  3  a real holder, cwd = this repository    truth HELD   namer: pid 2320801, cwd named
  4  a real holder, cwd = /tmp               truth HELD   namer: pid 2321707, FOREIGN checkout

CELL 2 IS THE WHOLE MEASUREMENT. It reproduces fuser's false positive live — the old code's
answer and the new code's answer, on the same lockfile, at the same instant, one variable — so
this is not a claim that the repair works but a demonstration of the two answers differing on
the case that matters. Cell 1 is that cell's own control: without it, a namer that reports
nothing ALWAYS would pass cell 2. Cells 3 and 4 keep it from being a function that never speaks.

SHELLCHECK CLEAN, and the one finding it did raise was worth taking rather than silencing:
SC2086 on `set -- $line`, where the word-splitting was intentional. Rewritten to `read` into
NAMED fields, which is clearer and needs no suppression directive — a shellcheck disable with a
reason would have been defensible and this is better.

the caller volunteers, and its honest repair is structural: the lane takes the lock itself, so

being guessed at by a tool measuring the wrong thing.

chdirs after launch reports where it IS, not where it started. Where a lock is held through a

title: W3: fln-checker — structurally independent checker, WASM-clean, consensus seat
description:
Implement fln-checker, the independent kernel checker (§8.3b): a deliberately DIFFERENT second implementation, not a feature flag over fln-kernel — separate normalization algorithm (eager where K1/K2 are lazy), simpler persistent maps and substitutions, its OWN decoder over Grimoire canonical wire objects (never the primary heap nodes), no dependency on the unsafe membrane, an independently derived error-class mapping, a separate build artifact, and a WASM build for a foreign execution substrate (the WASM Judge second engine).

Non-sharing is proven STRUCTURALLY: CI verifies fln-checker shares data schemas but no semantic implementation modules with fln-kernel (dependency-graph rules). The checker joins the consensus policies of §8.3c: standard (deterministic content-seeded sample + all high-risk forms — never runtime randomness), release (full closure), paranoid (everywhere, optionally distinct hosts). The honest economics: roughly 2x kernel CPU where it runs, single-digit percent end-to-end (PG-1b measures it). Common-mode risk R6 (shared Judgment Specification misreading) is why FOREIGN witnesses (lean4checker, lean4lean via export) exist in the council; this bead includes wiring the external-witness sampling seam.

Acceptance: full agreement with K1/K2 on the corpus; a seeded spec-divergence mutant (deliberately misimplement one rule in a test build) is caught by the differential lane; WASM build passes the same vectors bit-for-bit. Tests: non-sharing CI check; consensus-policy integration tests where a planted disagreement HALTS publication with both traces attached (never outvoted).

## Acceptance Criteria

All bead-specific requirements, acceptance conditions, tests, invariants, compatibility surfaces, evidence levels, performance gates, negative/recovery cases, and user-visible behaviors stated above remain mandatory. In addition, the MANDATORY VERIFICATION DEFINITION OF DONE in Notes must be satisfied with named unit/property/mutation suites, at least one shared real-path no-mock E2E scenario plus failure/recovery coverage, detailed human and schema-versioned NDJSON artifacts, and reproducible close evidence. No listed feature or claim may be silently narrowed, deferred, mocked, or declared complete through an unclassified divergence.
design: FL-INV-02 CONSENSUS BOUNDARY — fln-checker is an independent veto/evidence seat, never an alternative admission authority. Its verdict and WASM/foreign witness results are serializable evidence but cannot construct the fln-kernel opaque checked state. Tests attempt receipt replay, forged checker success, stale-root success, unknown policy/version, and all-negative/one-positive vote combinations; none may publish when fln-kernel rejects or is inconclusive.
acceptance_criteria:
fln-checker is a separate artifact and genuinely independent implementation: its own canonical-wire decoder, eager normalization strategy, maps/substitutions, error mapping and code modules; it shares only reviewed data schemas with fln-kernel, has no unsafe-membrane dependency, and builds/runs WASM-clean. Structural CI derives workspace dependencies/source ownership and rejects semantic implementation sharing. It agrees declaration-by-declaration with K1/K2 across the complete required corpus and identical native/WASM vectors. Standard policy uses deterministic content-seeded samples plus all high-risk forms, release checks the full closure, paranoid checks everywhere and may use distinct hosts; runtime randomness is forbidden. Checker/foreign-witness verdicts are veto/evidence seats only and cannot construct the kernel opaque accepted capability; any disagreement halts with traces, never votes through publication. Unit/property/model/differential/mutation tests cover each rule, decoder discrepancy, policy/sample determinism, stale roots, unknown versions, malformed wire objects, resource/cancellation outcomes, native/WASM identity, receipt replay, forged success, and all vote combinations; a seeded spec-rule divergence is detected. Real no-mock consensus E2E runs K1/K2/checker plus foreign witnesses, plants one-engine disagreements, restores, and retains strict policy/sample/root/verdict/trace/publication bundles. PG-1b overhead is measured honestly with raw samples and never used as correctness evidence. Dependencies, scripts/check.sh, cargo/fmt/clippy/UBS, nonsharing/unsafe/dependency guards, WASM/differential/mutation/platform lanes pass. No feature flag over kernel, shared semantic module, checker-as-authority, quorum override, random sampling, mock-only WASM/foreign witness, unresolved disagreement, or deferred listed behavior satisfies closure.

REVIEW AMENDMENT — the independent checker includes a deliberately simple numeric implementation whose semantic code, normalization, algorithms, and test-oracle path are not shared with fln-bignum or K1/K2. Shared wire schemas are allowed; shared decision code is not. Build-graph and seeded common-bug checks enforce this non-sharing boundary, while cross-implementation property and real artifact tests require agreement.

EVIDENCE CONTRACT — authoritative output is strict schema-versioned canonical semantic NDJSON containing normalized inputs, roots, typed outcomes, resource class/consumption, decisions, first divergence, cleanup, and exact final state. Host, PID, wall time, temporary paths, cache/performance facts, and scheduler details live only in a separately linked bounded telemetry stream and cannot enter authoritative digests. Validators reject merged streams, unknown versions, extra or missing fields, broken linkage/order, silent truncation, or telemetry-root drift. Productive 1/8/32 runs prove nonempty completed work and deterministic reduction rather than thread-count labels.
notes:
MANDATORY VERIFICATION DEFINITION OF DONE (inherits franken_lean-rur; additive to this bead's own Tests/Acceptance):
1. Unit coverage: deterministic happy-path, boundary, malformed-input, resource-exhaustion, cancellation, and failure-atomicity cases for every new public behavior; property/metamorphic and mutation-kill tests wherever an invariant or equivalence is claimed.
2. E2E coverage: add or extend at least one shared scripts/e2e scenario for the real user-visible path, plus a negative/recovery scenario. Release-level evidence uses the no-mock lane (real Reference binary/artifact/filesystem/editor/process/host as applicable). A mock may support a unit test but may not close an L-level, PG gate, or public claim.
3. Detailed logs: emit both concise human logs and schema-versioned NDJSON with run/scenario/step ids; bead, claim, invariant, Parity-Ledger row, and gate ids; exact command/argv with secrets redacted; cwd; epoch/mode/profile/platform/thread-count/seed/cache-state/host facts; canonical input hashes; expected vs actual; monotonic start/end/duration; resource and budget facts; exit status/signal; stdout/stderr artifact references; receipt/logical roots; first-divergence data; cleanup and asserted final state. Never swallow stderr, never leak secrets, and bound adversarial log volume.

The close evidence names every test/scenario id and artifact location; skips require a typed, logged, honest L-level limitation and may not satisfy the skipped claim.

comments.text:
THE THIRD THING THAT GETS BUILT WRONG IF BUILT AFTER THE ENGINE: THE SAMPLING POLICY. cc_2, 2026-07-25.

Posting this on gii rather than on my own beads because this is where it belongs and where whoever builds the checker will read it. Analysis only - no bead filed, close mode is on.

TWO ARE NOW BUILT, BOTH WHILE THERE WAS NOTHING TO CONSTRAIN. fln-uc44 built the consensus seat while there was nothing to vote: it halts, it cannot construct the kernel's opaque capability, and there is no quorum anywhere in it. franken_lean-r0xu wrote the independence boundary and then FLN-STRUCT-037 made it fire, while fln-checker still has no code. Both were cheap precisely because nothing existed yet to argue for an exception.

THE THIRD IS THE SAMPLING POLICY, and it is the one I would build next.

WHY IT ARRIVES WITH THE ENGINE, NOT AFTER IT. gii's own estimate is that the checker costs roughly 2x kernel CPU where it runs. The first engineering response to a 2x cost is always to run it less. So the pressure to sample does not appear some months later when someone gets sloppy - it appears in the same week the engine first works, applied by someone who is right that it is too slow.

WHAT IT DEGRADES INTO IF BUILT THEN. "Sample randomly." "Sample a percentage." "Skip the slow ones." The third is exactly backwards: the expensive declarations are the ones most likely to be wrong - deep defeq tails, large inductive blocks, literal-heavy arithmetic - so a cost-driven sample systematically avoids the population it exists to check. gii already specifies the right shape: a deterministic content-seeded sample PLUS all high-risk forms, never runtime randomness.

TWO PROPERTIES THAT ARE CHEAP NOW AND UNRECOVERABLE LATER.

  1. DETERMINISM. FL-INV-01 requires the same input closure to yield the same artifacts. If the sample is drawn with runtime randomness, two runs over the same corpus check different declarations and neither is reproducible. Worse, it is RETROACTIVE: the moment rand() enters, every previously green run's coverage becomes unknowable, because you can no longer reconstruct what was checked. Content-seeded costs nothing today and cannot be retrofitted onto evidence already claimed.
  2. THE HIGH-RISK FLOOR. "All high-risk forms" has to be a floor the sample cannot dip below, defined BY FORM - recursors, nested inductives, quotient init, literal acceleration, deep universe terms. Built later, "high-risk" silently gets redefined as "whatever is currently failing", which is the one definition that guarantees the floor never catches anything new.

WHY THIS ONE RATHER THAN THE OTHER CANDIDATES, and this is the actual argument: IT IS THE ONLY ONE WHOSE FAILURE LEAVES NO TRACE.

  - A seat built wrong is observable: a disagreement either halts or it does not, and the planted-disagreement test says which.
  - A boundary built wrong is observable: a violation is a build failure, and the planted-violation tests prove the guard fires.
  - A sampling policy built wrong produces NO SIGNAL AT ALL. It just quietly checks less. A green sampled run tells you nothing about whether the sample covered the bug, and there is no artifact that would reveal the policy was wrong. You cannot test your way to noticing it afterwards.

That is the same shape as fln-8zsq, where the corpus census ran at a single thread width and its schedule-independence was inferred rather than measured: a coverage decision that yields a number reading stronger than it is. The difference is that fln-8zsq was recoverable by writing the claim class next to the number. A sampling policy is not, because the number it damages is the coverage itself.

RUNNER-UP, NAMED SO IT IS NOT LOST: THE DISAGREEMENT CARVE-OUT REGISTRY. When two engines disagree, something adjudicates. Built late, "adjudicate" becomes "the kernel is probably right, mark the checker flaky, add a row to an exceptions file" - a suppression list wearing a registry's clothes. The precedent is already in this tree: the corpus census carries restrictive_with_carve_out, and D23 governs when a carve-out is legitimate. A registry built BEFORE there is any disagreement to excuse will demand a justification per row as a matter of course; built after, the first row is added at 2am to make CI green and the second one cites the first.

I rank it second only because it does leave a trace - rows accumulate and someone can count them - so it is recoverable in a way the sampling policy is not.

WHAT I AM NOT PROPOSING. Not Slice C, and not building either of these now. The seat and the boundary were authorised one at a time and that pacing is why they came out right. This is the answer to "what is third", not a request to start it.

title: W3 fln-checker KR-109 Let inference
description:
Implement the independent checker KR-109 Let inference on top of the closed KR-100 through KR-108
dispatcher. At HEAD crates/fln-checker/src/infer.rs returns Deferred(InferenceDeferred::Let) for
every ExprNode::Let, so a let-bearing term is a typed nonanswer rather than a rejection and no
checker verdict exists for it. This slice replaces that deferral with production semantics.

Let inference is a three-part judgment and each part is separately observable. The declared binder
type is inferred and forced through checker-owned WHNF to a Sort, because a let annotation that is
not a type is a rejection and not a deferral. The bound value is checked against that declared type
under the checker's own resource-counted definitional equality, so a value whose type is only
definitionally equal to the annotation is accepted while a genuine mismatch is a typed rejection
carrying the exact binder site. The body is inferred under a deterministic capture-safe query-local
binder for the let variable, and the inferred body type has the bound VALUE zeta-substituted for
that variable, which is what distinguishes KR-109 from ordinary lambda binding: the let is
transparent to typing, so the result may mention the value and must not mention the internal name.

Nested and sequential lets are flattened onto the existing heap-continuation machine rather than
traversed recursively, because let depth is attacker-controlled exactly as telescope depth is. Both
checking and infer-only modes run every part. Non-Sort annotations, value/annotation mismatches,
nested WHNF refusal, resource exhaustion, cancellation, and malformed private arenas remain
distinct typed outcomes with clean recovery, never collapsed into one another and never promoted to
acceptance or rejection.

This child covers KR-109 only. KR-110 literals, KR-112 projections, KR-203 zeta inside definitional
equality as a separate reduction rule, declaration admission, complete typing, additional WHNF or
definitional-equality rules, consensus, Reference or corpus parity, WASM Judge, fault-seeding
campaigns, parent closure, performance, and release evidence all remain outside it.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

KR-109 Let inference is implemented without recursive host traversal over attacker-controlled let
depth. The declared type is inferred, forced through checker-owned WHNF, and accepted only as a
Sort. The bound value is checked against the declared type through the checker's own definitional
equality with resources counted and cancellation observed. The body is inferred under a
deterministic query-local binder whose name cannot collide with or capture input, context, or
constant free names, and the inferred body type is the body type with the bound value substituted
for that binder, preserving let transparency and never leaking an internal name. Both checking and
infer-only modes exercise every part.

Named tests cover: a dependent let whose body type mentions the bound value; a non-dependent let; a
let whose annotation is only definitionally equal to the value's inferred type; a non-Sort
annotation rejected at the exact binder site; a value/annotation mismatch rejected with both sides
named; sequential and nested lets including a let bound to a let; a let under a lambda and a forall
and inside an application, so composition with the closed KR-107 and KR-108 continuations is
exercised; repeated display names and adversarial fresh-name collisions; a deep let chain in a
64 KiB-stack child process to prove stack safety; resource and cancellation checkpoints with clean
recovery; a malformed private arena as an internal fault with clean recovery; and production-path
independence from fln-kernel and fln-core semantic helpers. Unsupported KR-110 and KR-112 forms
must remain Deferred rather than rejected, and a test must prove that the deferral set SHRANK by
exactly the Let case rather than being replaced wholesale.

cargo fmt, locked all-target check, warnings-denied Clippy, the complete fln-checker suite, relevant
structure guards, same-path UBS comparison, and scripts/check.sh must pass or be classified
candidly. No declaration admission, complete typing, consensus, Reference or corpus parity, WASM,
fault-seeding campaign, parent closure, performance, or release claim is established by this child.

Scope delivered at the declared child boundary.

KR-109 Let inference replaces the typed nonanswer Deferred(InferenceDeferred::Let) with production
semantics in crates/fln-checker/src/infer.rs. Let chains are flattened onto the existing
heap-continuation machine rather than traversed recursively, because let depth is attacker-controlled
exactly as telescope depth is. Per binder and in order: the declared type is inferred and forced
through checker-owned WHNF to a Sort; the value is inferred and checked against the declared type
through the checker's own resource-counted definitional equality; a deterministic query-local binder
is installed carrying the DECLARED type rather than the value's inferred type, because the two are
only definitionally equal and KR-102 must read back what the term declared. The body is then inferred
and each bound value is substituted for its local innermost-first, so a let bound to another let
resolves through both.

A let is TRANSPARENT to typing. That is the whole distinction from KR-107: a lambda ABSTRACTS its
binder into a Pi, while a let's value flows into the inferred type and the internal local must not
survive. The cells are written against that distinction, because an implementation that abstracted
instead of substituting would still produce a well-formed type and would pass a weaker suite.

Both checking and infer-only modes run every part. That is deliberately stricter than the lambda
path, which skips its domain sort check when only inferring, and the reason is specific to this rule:
the value ends up INSIDE the resulting type, so an annotation that is not a type would put an
ill-typed term into a type even on an inference-only query.

NAMED CELLS, six, all passing.

kr109_let_body_type_carries_the_value_not_the_binder binds the zeta result in both modes and asserts
separately that no free name survives into the published type.
kr109_non_dependent_let_body_type_is_unchanged_by_zeta covers the case where substitution is a no-op
on the result.
kr109_sequential_and_nested_lets_flatten_and_substitute_innermost_first covers a let bound to another
let, which is the case that fails if the substitution order is reversed.
kr109_a_declared_type_that_is_not_a_sort_is_rejected_at_its_binder requires the refusal to name the
binder ordinal, not merely to occur.
kr109_a_value_whose_type_mismatches_the_annotation_is_rejected_naming_the_binder is the typed
rejection for the conversion failure.
kr109_the_deferral_set_shrank_by_exactly_the_let_case is the anti-vacuity cell: KR-110 and KR-112
must STILL defer, so a repair that replaced the deferral machinery wholesale rather than removing one
member of it fails here.

A REGRESSION I CAUSED IN AN UNRELATED RULE, AND THE FIRST DIAGNOSIS WAS WRONG.

fifty_thousand_binder_forall_telescope_fits_a_64k_stack began overflowing its stack. It is a FORALL
test and this slice does not touch forall. I did not assume it was mine: the one-variable control is
that the same test passes at HEAD in a worktree, and that is what made it attributable.

new InferenceProgress counters took that struct from 176 to 240 bytes, and since it is returned by
value through the whole inference path InferenceStop went 224 to 288 and InferenceOutcome 248 to 320.

restoring every size to its exact HEAD value STILL failed. So the sizes were a real cost and not the
cause. The cause was run's own frame: three new match arms with their locals, in the single iterative
frame every rule shares on that 64 KiB thread. Moving them into inline-never helpers fixed it.

Two things were kept rather than discarded. KR-109 ships with NO progress counters at all, unlike
KR-107 and KR-108, and the source says why at the point a reader would otherwise add one. And
crates/fln-checker/tests/size_probe.rs pins the four sizes as ceilings with its own anti-vacuity
cell, so the next counter fails there with an explanation instead of overflowing a stack in a rule
its author never touched. That guard states its own limit in its own file: a size is not a stack
depth, and the frame growth that actually caused this is invisible to it.

GATES, all local and in the main tree, run through a wrapper script so a bare cargo test is not
offloaded to a worker.

formatter that writes.

cells.

or release claim is made. KR-110 literals and KR-112 projections still answer Deferred by design, and

title: W3 fln-checker KR-110 literal inference
description:
Implement the independent checker KR-110 literal inference on top of the closed KR-100 through
KR-109 dispatcher. Before this slice crates/fln-checker/src/infer.rs returned
Deferred(InferenceDeferred::NatLiteral) and Deferred(InferenceDeferred::StringLiteral) for every
literal, so a literal-bearing term received a typed nonanswer and never a checker verdict. That is
FL-INV-07-correct and it is not coverage.

KR-110 is a LEAF rule and differs from every other leaf in one respect that decides its whole shape:
a literal's type is a CONSTANT the term does not contain. Every other leaf copies a type out of an
arena it was handed; this one must BUILD one. A Nat literal is typed by the constant Nat and a
String literal by the constant String, each with no universe arguments.

The environment is consulted rather than trusted. A literal whose type constant is not declared is a
typed rejection naming that constant, not a deferral, because the question is answered rather than
open, and not a panic. The universe arity is checked even though it is always zero for a well-formed
environment, because an environment declaring Nat with level parameters is malformed input and must
refuse rather than silently instantiate nothing. The constant's own declared type is deliberately not
re-checked: KR-105 does not re-check a constant's type either, and doing it here would smuggle
KR-972's preamble law into this rule.

The rule adds no InferenceProgress counters and no width to any type returned by value on the
inference path. That is a constraint inherited from franken_lean-gii.20 rather than a preference:
KR-109 overran the 64 KiB stack budget shared by every rule, in an unrelated Forall cell, by growing
frames. crates/fln-checker/tests/size_probe.rs holds the ceilings that refuse a repeat.

This child covers KR-110 only. KR-112 projections, declaration admission, complete typing, additional
WHNF or definitional-equality rules, literal REDUCTION as distinct from literal typing, consensus,
Reference or corpus parity, WASM Judge, fault-seeding campaigns, parent closure, performance, and
release evidence all remain outside it.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

Both literal forms infer their declared type constants in both checking and infer-only modes. A
literal whose type constant is absent from the environment is a typed UnknownConstant rejection
naming the constant, never a deferral and never a fault. A type constant declared with universe
parameters is refused on arity, and that cell must feed malformed input deliberately, because a check
that cannot fire on well-formed input is the kind that gets deleted as dead. The constructed type is
a single-node arena with an empty level arena, and allocation failure is a typed fault rather than a
panic.

An anti-vacuity cell must assert that after this slice exactly ONE deferral family remains, KR-112
projections, so that a repair which emptied the deferral machinery wholesale rather than removing two
members of it fails. The KR-109 anti-vacuity cell and the general deferral census must both be
updated to the new population rather than deleted, and the update must be visible as a narrowing.

The three 64 KiB deep-stack cells and the size_probe ceilings must be re-run as regression cover,
because the failure mode this rule is written to avoid is invisible in this rule's own tests.

cargo fmt, warnings-denied Clippy, the complete fln-checker suite, and a same-path UBS comparison
against a baseline verified byte-identical to the base commit must pass or be classified candidly.
No declaration admission, complete typing, consensus, Reference or corpus parity, WASM,
fault-seeding campaign, parent closure, performance, or release claim is established by this child.

the constant Nat and a String literal by the constant String, each with no
universe arguments.

WHY ITS SHAPE DIFFERS FROM EVERY OTHER LEAF, which is the substance of the slice
rather than a detail. A literal's type is a CONSTANT THE TERM DOES NOT CONTAIN.
Every other leaf rule copies a type out of an arena it was handed; this one must
build a one-node arena with an empty level arena. ArenaAssembler was deliberately
NOT widened with a push_constant for it: the assembler has push_sort, push_apply
and push_forall, this rule would be the only caller of a fourth, and every
widening of these types is paid out of the 64 KiB stack budget shared by every
rule. The construction follows nat_reduce.rs's existing shape, including
try_reserve_exact, so an allocation failure is a typed fault and not a panic.

THE ENVIRONMENT IS CONSULTED RATHER THAN TRUSTED. A literal whose type constant is
not declared is a typed UnknownConstant rejection naming that constant. It is not
a deferral, because the question is answered rather than open, and it is not a
fault. Universe arity is checked even though it is always zero in a well-formed
environment, because an environment declaring Nat with level parameters is
malformed input and must refuse rather than silently instantiate nothing. The
constant's own declared type is deliberately not re-checked, because KR-105 does
not re-check a constant's type either and doing it here would smuggle KR-972's
preamble law into this rule.

deliberately, because a check that cannot fire on well-formed input is the kind

emptied the deferral machinery wholesale rather than removing two members of it

title: W3 fln-checker KR-112 projection inference
description:
Implement the independent checker KR-112 projection inference on top of the closed KR-100 through
KR-110 dispatcher. At the filing, crates/fln-checker/src/infer.rs returns
Deferred(InferenceDeferred::Projection) for every ExprNode::Projection, and after the KR-110 slice
that is the LAST deferral family in the inference dispatcher. Two anti-vacuity cells are already
pinned to a population of exactly one, so this slice cannot land silently: both
kr109_the_deferral_set_shrank_by_exactly_the_let_case and
unsupported_rule_families_are_deferred_and_metadata_does_not_change_the_requirement must be narrowed
again, and the second asserts the population exactly.

THE RULE. For Projection { structure_name, index, expression }, infer the scrutinee's type and force
it through checker-owned WHNF to a constant application whose head is structure_name. The structure's
projection rule supplies the constructor name and the parameter count. The constructor's declared
type is a telescope: the first parameter_count binders are the structure's parameters and the
remainder are its fields. The result is the type of field index, with the parameters instantiated
from the scrutinee type's arguments and each earlier field replaced by a projection of the same
scrutinee, because a later field's type may mention an earlier one.

THE METADATA IS CALLER-SUPPLIED AND MUST BE TREATED AS UNTRUSTED, WHICH IS THE HEART OF THIS SLICE.
Measured at the filing: the checker's ConstantDeclaration carries only level parameters, type, kind,
safety and an optional definition body. It has NO field list, NO parameter count and NO link from an
inductive to its constructor. The structure metadata KR-112 needs lives instead in
WhnfContext::projection_rules as ProjectionRule { structure_name, constructor_name, parameter_count },
reachable from inference through InferenceContext::reduction, and it is supplied by the CALLER rather
than derived from the environment or validated by it.

That makes every field of a projection rule attacker-controlled input to this rule. A missing rule
for the named structure, a constructor_name that is not a declared constant, a constructor whose kind
is not Constructor, a parameter_count exceeding the constructor telescope's length, an index past the
last field, and a scrutinee whose type does not reduce to the named structure are each a typed
outcome and never a panic and never a silent acceptance. Consult, do not trust: the same decision
KR-110 made about its type constants, one level harder because the untrusted value is a count used to
split a telescope.

This child covers KR-112 inference only. Projection REDUCTION, which is KR-204 and KR-902 and already
lives in whnf, is outside it, as are declaration admission, complete typing, additional WHNF or
definitional-equality rules, consensus, Reference or corpus parity, WASM Judge, fault-seeding
campaigns, parent closure, performance, and release evidence.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

Projection inference is implemented without recursive host traversal over attacker-controlled
structure depth, and adds no InferenceProgress counters and no width to any type returned by value on
the inference path. Those are inherited constraints rather than preferences: franken_lean-gii.20
overran the 64 KiB stack budget shared by every rule, in an unrelated Forall cell, by growing frames,
and crates/fln-checker/tests/size_probe.rs holds the ceilings that refuse a repeat. The three
deep-stack cells and both size_probe cells must be re-run as regression cover, because that failure
mode is invisible in this rule's own tests.

The scrutinee's type is inferred, forced through checker-owned WHNF, and accepted only as an
application of the named structure. Parameters are instantiated from that type's arguments and each
earlier field is substituted by a projection of the same scrutinee, so a dependent field type is
correct rather than merely well-formed. Both checking and infer-only modes run every part.

Named cells cover: a non-dependent field; a DEPENDENT field whose type mentions an earlier field,
which is the cell that fails against an implementation that forgets the substitution and still
produces a well-formed type; a parameterized structure, so parameter instantiation is exercised
rather than assumed; and one typed refusal per untrusted-input failure above, each naming its own
cause rather than collapsing into a single generic rejection. Resource and cancellation checkpoints
with clean recovery are required, and the coverage row will refuse to validate without them.

The anti-vacuity requirement is inverted for this slice and must be stated as such: after KR-112 the
deferral set is EMPTY, so the two existing cells cannot simply be narrowed to a smaller population.
They must be replaced by a cell asserting that no inference deferral remains reachable, and that
replacement must fail if a future rule family is added as a deferral without updating it. A slice
that deletes the cells rather than replacing them is refused.

cargo fmt, warnings-denied Clippy, the complete fln-checker suite, and a same-path UBS comparison
against a baseline verified byte-identical to the base commit must pass or be classified candidly. No
declaration admission, complete typing, consensus, Reference or corpus parity, WASM, fault-seeding
campaign, parent closure, performance, or release claim is established by this child.
close_reason: KR-112 projection inference landed at 2e02eb4d on the slice filed at 9ac7d514, removing the last rule-family deferral from the checker's inference dispatcher. Caller-supplied projection-rule fields are treated as untrusted input with a distinct typed refusal each; five named cells including a dependent-field cell and a replacement anti-vacuity cell bound exhaustively to InferenceDeferred, which caught three dead variants still advertising unimplemented rules. fmt/clippy/full fln-checker suite green, UBS zero new criticals against a same-path baseline. scripts/check.sh was not run and parent franken_lean-gii remains open.

WHAT THE RULE DOES. Projection inference replaces the typed nonanswer
Deferred(InferenceDeferred::Projection). The scrutinee's inferred type is reduced
through checker-owned WHNF and its head required to be the structure the
projection names. The rule's constructor and parameter count come from the
reduction context. The constructor's declared type is a telescope: its first
parameter_count binders are instantiated with the structure's own arguments, then
each earlier field is instantiated with a projection of the SAME scrutinee,
because a later field's type may mention an earlier one. The requested field's
domain is the result.

THE METADATA IS CALLER-SUPPLIED, AND THAT IS THE SUBSTANCE OF THE SLICE. Measured
at the filing and unchanged: the checker's ConstantDeclaration carries no field
list, no parameter count and no inductive-to-constructor link. The structure
metadata lives in WhnfContext::projection_rules as ProjectionRule with
structure_name, constructor_name and parameter_count, supplied by the caller
through InferenceContext::new_with_projection_rules -- not derived from the
environment and not validated by it. Every field of a rule is therefore untrusted
input, and each way it can be wrong has its own typed outcome rather than a shared
generic rejection: ProjectionRuleMissing when no rule is registered for the named
structure; ProjectionStructureMismatch when the scrutinee's type does not reduce
to that structure; ProjectionArityExceeded when parameter_count exceeds the
supplied arguments or the field index runs past the telescope; UnknownConstant
when the rule names a constructor that is not declared; ConstantUniverseArity when
its level arity disagrees with the structure application.

recording. needless_range_loop pointed at the parameter walk, where the loop

scrutinee, which is the cell that separates a correct rule from one that forgets

EXHAUSTIVELY, so a future rule family added as a deferral makes the file fail to
COMPILE rather than fail to assert -- the only form a future author who does not
know the cell exists cannot skip. It did not compile: the enum still declared

CONSTRUCTING them but never removed them, so the enum went on advertising three
rule families as unimplemented, with no construction site anywhere in src. All
three are removed.

offloaded to a worker lacking the tracker and the pin. cargo fmt -p fln-checker
--check clean. cargo clippy -p fln-checker --all-targets with warnings denied,
clean. cargo test -p fln-checker green across all sixteen targets, including the
three 64 KiB deep-stack cells and both size_probe ceilings, re-run as regression
cover because the frame-growth failure mode KR-109 hit is invisible in this rule's
own tests.

parent, verified byte-identical to the base for both files, same relative paths,
scanned from its own tree root, so exactly one variable moved. Baseline Critical
13, Warning 493, Info 159. After Critical 13, Warning 511, Info 169. ZERO new
criticals. The thirteen are pre-existing, which establishes attribution and not
